title: Evaluation of a constructed CNF
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $c_1,\ldots,c_r$ be a list of clauses on $n$ variables, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. The CNF formula formed from this list evaluates to true on $x$ exactly when every clause in the list evaluates to true on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of clauses on $n$ variables is given
$x$ is an assignment to the $n$ variables
